newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Parexel Int'l raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Parexel Int'l raised.

text.p: -- Vector Securities International Inc said on Monday it upgraded Parexel International Corp to buy from neutral based in part on recent weakness among Contract Research Organization (CRO) sector stocks that makes Parexel more of a bargain for investors.
-- Vector said the CRO group is down 19 percent for the year to date and down 11 percent over the last week.

-- Vector said Parexel has enjoyed acceleration in revenues, margins and earnings in the past year as its investment in global expansion paid off. Parexel is now the fourth-largest CRO, but is generating the best trends in the group with organic growth of more than 60 percent, Vector said.
-- Vector set a 12-month price target of $34 a share.
-- Parexel shares were up 1/2 Monday at 24.
